name: Make It Last
source:
Make It Last is a sweet visual novel that follows the lives of Harvey Chapman and Jordan Min; two guys that found each other, and fell in love.

This game was made for [url=https://itch.io/jam/self-care-jam-2]Self Care Jam 2[/url].

[From [url=https://destinyfailsus.itch.io/makeitlast]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《让它延续》是一部温柔的视觉小说，讲述哈维·查普曼和乔丹·敏的生活。他们找到了彼此，并坠入爱河。

本作为[url=https://itch.io/jam/self-care-jam-2]Self Care Jam 2[/url]制作。

[来源：[url=https://destinyfailsus.itch.io/makeitlast]Itch.io[/url]]
